Columbus Day vs. Indigenous Peoples' Day Debate

The debate over whether to recognize Columbus Day or Indigenous Peoples' Day is ongoing, with some regions and individuals choosing to observe Indigenous Peoples' Day. This shift reflects a broader societal re-evaluation of historical figures and their impact. The differing observances highlight a cultural and political divide regarding how to acknowledge history and honor diverse communities.
